.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Delivery profile: shaped 0.6/0.2/0.2 behind two zero-weight gates and a functional floor; verdict/severity/evidence rules)
evidence: Policy bytes are template-identical: tests/scoring.toml (95f70d6e...), tests/tools/score.py (13de2b38...) and tests/test.sh (bd682592...) match rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests byte-for-byte. scoring.toml:1-3 sets [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0 (thresholds, not weights); [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (sum 1, gates absent from weights, so gates carry no reward mass); [floors] functional = 0.05. Both gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with one binary criterion. score.py:41 gates_passed = all(score > 0.0); :42-44 scored dims forced to 0 unless gates passed and scored/reward.json exists; :46 weighted sum uses weights only; :47-48 reward = 0.0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed (functional > 0.05); :83 exits 1 on gate failure. test.sh:212 removes stale scored/ before gates; :213-222 runs gates suite then score.py, exit 1 -> 'exit 0' keeping the detailed zero record and SKIPPING the scored suite (:224), other codes -> write_zero_reward; :224-227 scored suite then score.py, failure -> zero. write_zero_reward at :60 plus trap ensure_reward at :61 cover all exits. Executed a copy of the frozen score.py+scoring.toml (python -B, scratchpad, frozen tree untouched) on synthetic RewardKit outputs: all pass -> 1.0; render=0 with perfect scored present -> reward 0.0, exit 1; constraints=0 -> 0.0, exit 1; gates pass but no scored -> 0.0; functional 0 with polish=visual=1 -> weighted 0.4 but reward 0.0 (floors_passed 0); functional exactly 0.05 -> 0.0; gates-only (all scored 0) -> 0.0; missing/out-of-range dimension -> exit 2 (test.sh writes plain zero). Plausible broken app: a polished static/shell UI that renders sign-in but cannot post — fails the constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml requires posting 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' to M-11 that survives reload and is visible to harriet in a separate context) and would also be zeroed by the in-dimension browser gate in each scored prompt; even if it slipped through, functional 0 hard-zeros the reward. Conforming-alternative-could-fail probe: gates require only sign-in plus one persistent cross-user post, which any conforming app satisfies, so no stronger app is gated out. Limitation noted (not a defect): functional total weight is 44 (3+4+4+2+1.5+4+4+2+3+1.5+1.5+1.5+2.5+1.5+4+4); single criteria of weight 1.5 or 2.0 alone stay below the 0.05 floor (measured 0.0), while one of weight >=2.5 clears it (measured reward 0.4341 at func=2.5/44 with perfect polish/visual). Such an app already passes the post/persist gate and a real functional criterion, so it is not 'non-working'; the floor value is template-controlled and must not be changed. No full configured grading run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says so); this row's behaviour is established by template identity, source trace of test.sh and direct execution of score.py, not by an end-to-end RewardKit run.
